description.value: A glass vial of potent corrosive liquid. Thrown as a ranged attack (Dexterity + Ranged Combat), a direct hit deals [[/damage 4 type=acid]] damage. All creatures within 5 feet of the impact point take [[/damage 2 type=acid]] damage. Applied to an object — a lock, hinge, or chain — for 1 minute, acid deals [[/damage 4]] damage to the object.
